title: FarmTact V18 — Immediate card-return focus
summary: V18 preserves the V17 integrated farm experience while making detail-card returns immediately accessible to keyboard users.

changes.title: Restore action focus and position immediately
changes.description: Returning from Explain, review or detail cards now focuses the originating action during layout and returns to its visible reading position.

changes.title: Keep immutable V17 workflows intact
changes.description: The change retains the ordinary sandbox, five contextual tool groups, agent workflows, local calculation, explicit approval and recorded simulation boundaries.
